reviews.summary: Parsed -i controls the timed launch count. Source dispatches Width=1,4,or 8 by mean row length; all corresponding SASS variants show CSR input loads, double multiply/accumulation, loop backedges, and output stores. Native host assembly retains an iteration counter/backedge around the actual launch for each specialization, including Width=8 used for large rows.

source_evidence.claim: The kernel traverses each row's CSR interval and writes its output; runIterations launches each requested iteration; -i sets iterations; dispatch selects Width=1,4,or 8 for all matrix rows according to mean length.

compiled_evidence.claim: Width=4 timed control contains an iteration counter/backedge and reaches cudaLaunchKernel before returning to that counter check.

Width=8 path records the timed start, increments and compares the counter with the iteration limit, calls cudaLaunchKernel, then branches back to the counter check; this is the large-mean-length dispatch path.
Width=1 path likewise records timed start, increments/checks iteration counter, launches through cudaLaunchKernel and returns to the counter check.

Each dispatched emitted variant (Width=8/4/1) includes CSR-related global loads and double multiplication/accumulation, conditional loop backedges (Width 8 line 507, Width 4 line 1648, Width 1 line 2263), and output stores (519,1660,2271). Variants 1 and 4 are included because source dispatches them for smaller mean lengths.

reviews.notes: Only source and already-existing disassembly inspected; no compile or runtime verification. Repeated output overwrite is intended for y=A*x.

reviews.summary: Each rank owns a contiguous row interval and launches its local packed-CSR workload once per iteration. The disassembly directly shows initial slice/length loads, batch entry gathers, multiply/accumulation, loop backedges, tail handling, and the output store. Host assembly retains the repeated launch loop.

source_evidence.claim: Kernel maps threads to rows and traverses their packed slices and lengths; -i is parsed; rank partition boundaries determine local rows and matrix arrays; timed launches repeat once per iteration and gathered starts/counts follow partition boundaries.

compiled_evidence.claim: Native run code calls the device stub inside a counter loop, compares the counter with the limit, then checks launch status and synchronizes before ending timing.
Initial kernel code derives row/thread identity, exits out-of-range rows, and loads the row's encoded slice and length from global memory before work begins.
Batch body performs multiple double multiplications and accumulations, then conditionally branches back to continue packed-CSR batches.
Tail path loads packed row/column/value/vector inputs, performs DMUL/DADD, branches to repeat the entry body while work remains, then emits the per-row global output store.

reviews.notes: Packed CSR traversal and arithmetic are directly visible, not inferred from dispatch alone. MPI/device runtime coverage was not executed; rank interval and gather coverage are source-level only.

reviews.summary: Each rank repeats its local CSR SpMV for the requested iteration count. Native code inlines the timed iteration, row, and nonzero loops with indexed loads, accumulation, and row stores; source shows rank-local row/item slices and offset rebasing.

source_evidence.claim: -i is parsed; rank-local CSR offsets are rebased after scatter; the timed loop invokes spmvCpu once per iteration, and each row routine traverses its nonzero interval, accumulates products, and stores output.

compiled_evidence.claim: Timed main records start time, then runs an iteration counter around inlined row/nonzero loops with column/vector/value loads, multiply/add, output stores, and row/iteration backedges before the end-time call.

reviews.notes: MPI distribution was not run; partition/scatter coverage assessed from source only. Repeated output overwrite is consistent with doing matrix work on each iteration.

reviews.summary: Timed OpenMP workers partition all rows and repeat their owned rows for the requested iteration count. The compiled worker retains nested CSR/row loops, accumulation, stores, and the iteration backedge.

source_evidence.claim: -i is parsed; workers own adjacent intervals covering numRows and invoke spmvRows in an iteration loop; the worker traverses each row's CSR interval and stores output.

compiled_evidence.claim: Compiled main calls GOMP_parallel and then ends timing; each worker derives row ownership from thread id/count, loads CSR-indexed inputs, accumulates and stores products, and compares its iteration counter before the backedge.
Compiled spmvRows has delimiter and indexed data loads, multiply/add, output stores, and CSR/row loop backedges.

reviews.notes: Source and existing host disassembly only; OpenMP runtime scheduling was not executed. Adjacent interval formulas cover the full row domain.

primary_quality_check.method: Primary inspected all four pilot sources and emitted work: iteration parsing, owned row intervals, complete CSR/packed-row traversals, stores, and compiled iteration/row/nonzero backedges. Returned the initial GPU citations for precise arithmetic and complete dispatch coverage; accepted the revised evidence after inspection. No execution or compilation.
